analysis.reasonEn: Closed with 5 consecutive negative candles in the last 5 trading days, and the daily RSI attempted to enter the oversold territory at 36.8 but failed. With ADX at 9.9 indicating weak trend formation and MACD histogram continuing to worsen, the 5-day low and 20-day low are at the same level while the 5-day high has decreased, confirming a bearish pattern. Although increased volume near the lower Bollinger Band suggests potential retracement, a lack of trend reversal evidence warrants a wait-and-see approach.

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Maintaining a wait-and-see condition due to lack of trend reversal evidence.
